Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

sport — a physical game or activity. Example: I do sport every week.
play — to take part in a game or sport. Example: I play football on Saturday.
football — a sport played with a ball and two teams. Example: I play football on Saturday.
tennis — a sport played with rackets and a ball. Example: I play tennis on Sunday.
swim — to move through water. Example: I can swim well.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• I play football.
• I do sport every week.
• Can you swim?
• I can swim well.
• It is healthy.

Grammar focus: Like / Love / Hate + -ing.
Use play with ball sports and do with activities: I play football. I do sport every week. Use can for ability: I can swim.
